_comment: Baseline of KNOWN wire-shape drift between the OpenClaw plugin's wire-bound TS interfaces and the AxonFlow agent OpenAPI spec at openapi_specs_sha. The CI gate fails on drift OUTSIDE this baseline. Entries here should be burned down over time via targeted PRs that either (a) update the plugin interface, (b) update the spec to document the missing fields (file platform-side), or (c) mark the type @sdkDerived if it is a plugin-side derivation that will not live on the wire. Generated by scripts/wire-shape/refresh.js. | 2026-09-06 (#193): interfaces aligned to the agent spec at enterprise main (v10.4.0) while the pin still points at 4cc8a0c9 (2026-04-25): MCPCheckInputResponse.redacted and MCPCheckOutputResponse.redaction_evaluated are sdk_only here only because the pinned spec predates them, and MCPCheckOutputResponse.policy_matches is spec_only here because the pinned spec still had it; all three vanish when the pin moves to the public repo's v10.4.0 commit (mirror PR #486). At that pin the flat schema map will also report four spec_only members on DecisionExplanation (context, context_truncated, latest_policy_version, policy_version_at_decision) - those belong to orchestrator-api.yaml's HOMONYM of that name, which overwrites the agent's type in the loader; the bump PR must scope registered types to agent-api.yaml rather than baseline them.
